steps.summary: Run NE to climb stairs onto the rampart wall → Then run straight North-West along the wall into The Sarn Encampment
steps.layout_tell: Two-part linear zone: bottom path goes NE to stairs, top wall path goes NW to Town.
steps.next_exit: Enter The Sarn Encampment → Exit into The Toxic Conduits
steps.portal_tip: Enter The Toxic Conduits via the sewer grate right below Clarissa in Town!

actions.text: Climb onto the rampart wall & run NW to the end
Drop down into The Sarn Encampment → Enter The Toxic Conduits

variants.title: U-Turn Rampart Wall
variants.desc: Run NE on ground, then NW on top of the wall.

steps.summary: Look at the black sludge splash at the entrance grate — follow that direction to Doedre's Cesspool → Kill Doedre
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ BLACK SPLASH TELL: At the very first intersection in Toxic Conduits, a black ink/sludge stain on the floor points toward Doedre's Cesspool!
steps.next_exit: Kill Doedre the Vile → Tag Sewer Outlet WP → Exit RIGHT into The Quay
steps.portal_tip: Click the Valve in the middle of Doedre's arena whenever her cauldron stacks get high!

actions.text: Follow the black sludge splash direction into Doedre's Cesspool
Open Loose Grate → Kill Doedre the Vile (use Valve in center!)
Tag Sewer Outlet WP → Take the RIGHT exit into The Quay

steps.boss_info: Doedre the Vile: Rotates Purple (Enfeeble), Red (Physical/Bleed), and Green (Temp Chains/Chaos) phases.
steps.gem_reward: Unlocks both Solaris and Lunaris wings.

variants.title: Sludge Pointer
variants.desc: Black floor splash at start points toward the exit.

steps.summary: Follow main dock road: 1st wooden pier bridge holds Ankh of Eternity → Further along road is Resurrection Site (Tolman +1 Pt!) → Exit to Grain Gate
steps.layout_tell: Never miss the Ankh of Eternity BEFORE reaching Clarissa & Tolman's arena!
steps.next_exit: Loot Ankh of Eternity → Resurrect Tolman (+1 Skill Pt!) → Enter The Grain Gate
steps.portal_tip: The Ankh of Eternity is always in a Sealed Casket across a narrow wooden bridge on the water side!

actions.text: Check water-side wooden bridge for Sealed Casket → Loot Ankh of Eternity
Find Clarissa at Resurrection Site → Survive waves & kill Tolman (+1 Pt!)
Continue along the dock wall into The Grain Gate

steps.boss_info: Undying wave ambush at Tolman's arena.
steps.gem_reward: Love is Dead (Clarissa in Town): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: Linear Dockside
variants.desc: Order along path: Entrance → Ankh Bridge → Tolman Arena → Grain Gate.

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Kill Gemling Legionnaires in central trench (+1 Skill Pt!) → Follow doors with a CORPSE outside → Exit to Imperial Fields
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ CORPSE TELL: Whenever you approach a warehouse building in Grain Gate, look for a dead Blackguard corpse lying right outside the doorway — that doorway is ALWAYS the main path!
steps.next_exit: Kill Gemling Legionnaires (+1 Pt) → Follow Corpse Doorways → Enter The Imperial Fields
steps.portal_tip: Gemling Legionnaires spawn in an open courtyard midway through the zone!

actions.text: Tag Waypoint right inside entrance
Find & kill the Gemling Legionnaires squad (+1 Passive Skill Point!)
Enter warehouses marked by a dead corpse outside → Exit to Imperial Fields

steps.boss_info: Gemling Legionnaires: Trio of elemental/physical officers — focus them down one by one.
steps.gem_reward: The Gemling Legion (Maramoa): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: Corpse-Marked Warehouses
variants.desc: Dead body next to door = guaranteed right building.

steps.summary: Follow the cobblestone road North-West to the Waypoint, then take the right stone path into The Solaris Temple Level 1
steps.layout_tell: Follow the main stone road; past the Waypoint it splits Left (Solaris Concourse) and Right/Up (Solaris Temple).
steps.portal_tip: Enter Solaris Temple directly from Imperial Fields to grab the Sun Orb!

actions.text: Follow cobblestone road NW to the Waypoint
Continue North-East into The Solaris Temple Level 1

variants.title: Road to Solaris
variants.desc: Cobblestone road connects Grain Gate to Solaris.

steps.summary: Tag Solaris 1 WP → Find stairs to Level 2 → Kill Dawn & loot Sun Orb → Take WP back to Solaris 1 & exit to Solaris Concourse
steps.layout_tell: Follow carpet to the Solaris 1 Waypoint; after getting the Sun Orb in Level 2, logout/WP back to Solaris 1 and exit West into Solaris Concourse!
steps.next_exit: Kill Dawn in Level 2 (Sun Orb) → Exit Solaris 1 West into The Solaris Concourse
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ Tag the Solaris Level 1 Waypoint — it sits right next to the Solaris Concourse exit!

actions.text: Tag Solaris Temple Level 1 Waypoint (right beside Concourse door)
Enter Level 2 → Kill Dawn, Harbinger of Solaris & loot Sun Orb
Return to Solaris 1 WP → Exit West into The Solaris Concourse

steps.boss_info: Dawn, Harbinger of Solaris: Heavy Fire beams & degens.
steps.gem_reward: Sun Orb (1 of 2 orbs required for Harbour Bridge).

variants.title: Carpet to Level 2
variants.desc: Follow red/gold carpet through both levels.

steps.summary: Cross Solaris Concourse (tag WP) & enter The Bath House (skip Harbour Bridge for now) → Do Merciless Trial #1 & High Gardens (Yugul +1 Pt!)
steps.layout_tell: In The Bath House: North-West/West = Merciless Lab Trial #1 & High Gardens (Yugul +1 Pt); North-East = Exit to Lunaris Concourse!
steps.next_exit: Complete Merciless Trial #1 + Kill Yugul in High Gardens (+1 Pt) → Exit NE to The Lunaris Concourse
steps.portal_tip: Loot Wings of Vastiri from Hector Titucius' tomb inside The Bath House while passing through!

actions.text: Complete Merciless Lab Trial #1 (1/3) & loot Wings of Vastiri
Enter The High Gardens (NW) → Kill Yugul, Reflection of Terror (+1 Pt!)
Exit Bath House (NE) into The Lunaris Concourse

steps.boss_info: Yugul, Reflection of Terror: Spawns tracking Cold orbs — keep moving in circles and never stand still in cold balls!
steps.gem_reward: Reflection of Terror (Hargan): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: Bath House 3 Exits
variants.desc: West/NW = Trial #1 + High Gardens; NE = Lunaris Concourse.

steps.compass: TAG WP → MOON ORB IN LUNARIS 2
steps.summary: Run North to tag Lunaris Concourse Waypoint → Enter Lunaris Temple 1 & 2 → Kill Dusk & loot Moon Orb → Logout to Concourse WP
steps.layout_tell: Tag The Lunaris Concourse Waypoint right outside Lunaris Temple so you can teleport right back after looting the Moon Orb!
steps.next_exit: Kill Dusk in Lunaris Level 2 (Moon Orb) → Logout → Take WP to Lunaris Concourse → Go South to Harbour Bridge
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after picking up the Moon Orb → Take WP to Lunaris Concourse → Run South into The Harbour Bridge!

actions.text: Tag The Lunaris Concourse Waypoint right in front of Lunaris Temple
Traverse Lunaris Temple 1 & 2 → Kill Dusk & pick up Moon Orb
Logout to Town → Take WP to Lunaris Concourse → Go South to Harbour Bridge

steps.boss_info: Dusk, Harbinger of Lunaris: Heavy Cold projectiles & freezing cascades.
steps.gem_reward: Moon Orb (2 of 2 orbs required for Harbour Bridge).

variants.title: Concourse North-South
variants.desc: North = Lunaris Temple, South = Harbour Bridge.

steps.summary: Run straight along The Harbour Bridge into The Sky Shrine → Activate Statue → Kill Solaris & Lunaris → Enter Blood Aqueduct (Act 9)
steps.layout_tell: 100% linear bridge; The Sky Shrine boss arena is in the exact center.
steps.next_exit: Kill Solaris & Lunaris → Exit to The Blood Aqueduct (Act 9)
steps.portal_tip: Stand close to Solaris during her spear attacks and away from Lunaris's vortexes!

actions.text: Run straight to the center of The Harbour Bridge → Enter The Sky Shrine
Touch Statue → Defeat Solaris & Lunaris
Exit into The Blood Aqueduct (Act 9)

steps.boss_info: Solaris (Fire) & Lunaris (Cold): Swap phases at 50% HP. Unlocks Major Pantheon: Soul of Solaris & Soul of Lunaris!

variants.title: Linear Bridge
variants.desc: Boss arena is dead-center on the bridge.
